source.title: Larne Times, 9 October 1937, p. 8 ("Five Larne members returned unopposed")
source.publisher: Larne Times (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: 'The five retiring members were renominated, and no other nominations were received, so that the composition of the Council remains unchanged.' The ordinary day had been moved from May to October for the Coronation.

note: Annual election of five urban councillors, one for each ward, poll due 15 October 1937; all five retiring members were returned unopposed (Larne Times, 9 October 1937, p. 8). Returned unopposed.
